_about: Flow powers, batch B: sixteen 2nd-level and fourteen 3rd-level powers. Mechanics carried over from the SW5E force powers named in each entry's `sw5e`; every word and every name is Bad Eden's own. Built by tools/build-packs.mjs.
_unsure: SW5E's 'slowed level' condition has no D&D equivalent: Molasses (which IS the full slow) spells its effects out; Cold Front and Dust Devil render '1 slowed level' as 'speed halved'.
Dead Stop: Stun Droid was folded in per the brief — machines are affected too, but make a Constitution save instead of Wisdom (that was Stun Droid's save).
Shore Up is a max-HP increase, not healing, so it is a utility activity with the number in the text (a heal activity would apply it as healing).
Blood Price and My Share deal their self-damage through a damage activity with no type (Blood Price) / necrotic (My Share); the temp HP and the healing granted are in the text.
Call Down the Storm: the +1d10 in a natural storm is text only; the activity carries the base 3d10 (Dex save, half).
Splinter: 'on the same planet' rendered as 'wherever it goes'.

powers.name: Blackout
powers.description:
You pull the dark up out of the ground. It fills a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range, and it spreads around corners. Darkvision can't see through it, and ordinary light can't push it back.

If you center it on an object you're holding, or on one that isn't being worn or carried, the dark comes off the object and travels with it. Cover the object completely with something opaque and the dark stays put inside.

If the sphere overlaps light made by a power of 2nd level or lower, that light goes out.

powers.name: Bleed the Well
powers.description:
You reach into a creature you can see within range and start drawing the fight out of it. Make a ranged power attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage, and until the power ends it deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength.

At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the power ends.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2nd.

powers.name: Splinter
powers.description:
You leave something in a creature's head that doesn't come out. Choose one creature you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

On a failed save, you also always know where the target is, wherever it goes, for the duration. It can't hide from you, and being invisible does it no good against you.

This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

powers.name: Molasses
powers.description:
The air around one creature goes thick as syrup. Choose a creature you can see within range. It must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, for the duration its speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use reactions. On its turn it can take an action or a bonus action, not both, and no matter what it has or what it can do, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack on its turn.

If it tries to cast a power with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the power doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and it has to spend its action that turn to finish the casting. If it can't, the power is lost.

The creature makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the effect ends.

powers.name: Fever Dream
powers.description:
You put something in a creature's head that isn't there. Choose a creature you can see within range; it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you build an object, creature, or other visible thing of your choice, no bigger than a 10-foot cube, that only the target can perceive, for the duration. It has sound, temperature, and whatever else it needs. This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

The target can use its action to study the thing with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your power save DC. On a success, it sees through the dream and the power ends.

Until then, the target treats the dream as real and explains away anything that doesn't fit. Walk it onto a bridge that isn't there and it falls, and if it lives, it still believes in the bridge: it slipped, or the wind took it, or somebody pushed.

It's convinced enough to get hurt. A dream shaped like a creature can attack the target; a dream shaped like fire, acid, or a pit can burn or break it. Once each round on your turn, if the target is in the dream's space or within 5 feet of it, and the dream is something that could plausibly hurt it, the dream deals 1d6 psychic damage. The target feels it as whatever kind of hurt the dream would deal.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 20 feet, the dream can be 5 feet larger on a side, and you can target one additional creature for every two levels above 2nd.

powers.name: Cooler Heads
powers.description:
You take the heat out of a room. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail. For each creature that fails, choose one of the following.

You can hold down any effect that has the creature charmed or frightened. When this power ends, the held effect picks back up if it hasn't run out in the meantime.

Or you can make the creature indifferent toward creatures of your choice it was hostile to. That indifference ends if the creature is attacked or harmed by a power, or if it watches any of its friends get hurt. When the power ends, it goes back to hostile unless the GM says otherwise.

powers.name: Shore Up
powers.description:
You put a little of the current behind the people you're standing with. Choose up to three creatures within range. For the duration, each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 3rd level or higher, the increase goes up by 5 for each level above 2nd.

powers.name: Dead Stop
powers.description:
You tell a body to stop, and it listens. Choose a humanoid you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns it can make another Wisdom saving throw; on a success, the power ends on it.

It works on drones and other machines too, though a machine makes a Constitution saving throw instead.

powers.name: Set Right
powers.description: You lay a hand on a creature and put one thing back the way it was: end one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

powers.name: Steady the Line
powers.description:
You sit in the middle of the fight and hold it in your head. For the duration you give off a calm that reaches 5 feet around you: your side stands a little straighter, and the other side can't remember why it came.

Whenever you or a friendly creature inside the calm makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number to the roll.

Whenever a hostile creature enters the calm or starts its turn there, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it rolls a d4 and subtracts the number from each attack roll and saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it's immune to this power for 1 day.

powers.name: Bend the Will
powers.description:
You lean on a mind with the current until it leans the way you want. Suggest a course of action, a sentence or two, to a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune. The suggestion has to sound reasonable; ask the creature to harm itself and the power simply fails.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it does what you suggested as best it can, for as long as the power lasts. If the job takes less time than that, the power ends when the job is done.

You can set a condition that triggers the action during the duration: suggest, say, that a trader hand her truck to the first drifter who asks. If the condition never comes up before the power ends, nothing happens.

If you or any of your companions damage the target, the power ends. This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

powers.name: Heat Shimmer
powers.description: You go wavy, like a road in August. For the duration, every creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker that doesn't rely on sight, such as one with blindsight, or that can see through illusions, as with truesight, is immune to this effect.

powers.name: Nobody Here
powers.description: You convince the world there's nobody standing where you're standing. You become invisible until the power ends. Anything you're wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it stays on you. The power ends if you attack, cast a power, or do anything else hostile.

powers.name: Current Sight
powers.description:
You stop looking with your eyes and start looking with the current. Colors fade and dead things go grey. For the duration you gain the following benefits.

Living things glow with the Flow in them. Those that run Sephirotic glow blue, those that run Qliphothic glow red, and those that run neither way glow yellow. The brighter the glow, the deeper the current runs in them.

You have blindsight out to 30 feet.

You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight against living targets within 30 feet.

powers.name: Heave
powers.description:
You pick something up with the current and put it somewhere else, hard. Choose a Large or smaller creature, or an object that isn't being worn or carried, within range. The target must make a Strength saving throw; an object automatically fails. On a failed save it moves in a direction of your choice, how far depending on its size: Tiny up to 90 feet, Small up to 60 feet, Medium up to 30 feet, Large up to 10 feet. If it hits another creature or object at the end of that movement, both of them take 2d8 force damage.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 3rd level or higher, each distance increases by 10 feet (to a maximum of 90 feet) and the damage increases by 1d8, for each level above 2nd.

powers.name: Blood Price
powers.description:
You pay for a wall with the only coin the Flow takes. You take 2d8 damage that can't be reduced or prevented, and you gain temporary hit points equal to twice the damage you took. If the damage would drop you to 0 hit points, the power fails. While you have these temporary hit points, you have advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. Whatever's left of them goes away when the power ends.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2nd.

powers.name: Throttle
powers.description:
You close your hand on the air, and something across the room closes with it. Choose a creature within range. It must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save it takes 5d8 force damage and is restrained until the end of your next turn. On a successful save it takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

While the target is restrained this way, you can use a bonus action to move it up to 5 feet in any direction.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Cold Front
powers.description:
The temperature drops ten degrees wherever you're standing, and it stays dropped. For the duration, you wear the downstream like a coat.

Until the power ends, any attack you make deals an extra 1d8 necrotic damage when you hit a creature within 10 feet of you. A creature that takes this damage can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

Any creature of your choice that you can see that starts its turn within 10 feet of you has its speed halved until the start of your next turn.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 5th level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d8 for every two levels above 3rd.

powers.name: Pit Lightning
powers.description:
You open your hands and the pit comes out of them. A stroke of lightning 100 feet long and 5 feet wide leaps from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

The lightning sets fire to anything flammable in the line that isn't being worn or carried.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Howl
powers.description: You let out everything the current has been holding for you, all at once and at the top of your lungs. Each creature you choose within 15 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d6 psychic damage and 4d6 thunder damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save it takes half as much damage and isn't deafened.

powers.name: Night Terrors
powers.description:
You show them the thing under the bed, and it's real this time. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it's holding and become frightened for the duration. This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

While frightened this way, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest route it can find on each of its turns, unless there's nowhere to go. If it ends its turn somewhere it can't see you, it can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the power ends for that creature.

powers.name: Porch Light
powers.description: Somebody left a light on, and everyone can see it. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum possible hit points from any healing.

powers.name: Call Down the Storm
powers.description:
You ask the sky, and the sky's in a mood. A storm cloud 10 feet tall and 60 feet in radius forms in the air above you, centered on a point you can see within range; the power fails if there isn't room for it. When you cast the power, choose a point you can see under the cloud. Lightning strikes it, and each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. While the power lasts, you can use your action on any turn to call lightning down the same way.

If you're outdoors in a storm already, the power takes hold of that storm instead of making one, and the lightning damage increases by 1d10.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Lift the Curse
powers.description: At your touch, every curse on one creature or object ends. If the object is a cursed enhanced item, the curse stays in the thing, but the power breaks its owner's attunement so it can be put down and walked away from.

powers.name: My Share
powers.description:
You've got some to spare, and they don't. You take 4d8 necrotic damage, and one creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to twice the damage you took. This power has no effect on drones or other mindless machines.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Dust Devil
powers.description:
You stir the current until it stands up and spins. A field of churning telekinetic force fills the 15 feet around you for the duration, and it goes where you go.

When you cast this power, you can name any number of creatures you can see; the field leaves them alone. Every other creature in the area has its speed halved while it's there, and when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save it takes 3d8 force damage; on a successful save, half as much.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Stilling
powers.description:
You put a flat hand on the water and it goes still. Choose one creature, object, or Flow effect within range. Any Flow power of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each Flow power of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your casting ability against a DC of 10 + the power's level. On a success, that power ends.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, you automatically end a Flow power on the target if that power's level is equal to or less than the level you cast this at.

powers.name: Sever the Current
powers.condition: when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a Flow power
powers.description:
You cut the line between a caster and the current while they're still pulling on it. If the creature is casting a power of 3rd level or lower, its power fails and has no effect. If it's casting a power of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your casting ability against a DC of 10 + the power's level. On a success, the creature's power fails and has no effect.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the interrupted power fails outright if its level is equal to or less than the level you cast this at.

powers.name: Get Back
powers.description:
Everything, every direction, all at once. Each creature within 20 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 8d6 force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you. On a successful save it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

Small objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are shoved 5 feet away from you as well.

At higher levels. When you cast this power at 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 3rd.

powers.name: Quicksilver
powers.description:
You pour the current into someone and they come out the other side faster than the world. Choose a willing creature you can see within range. Until the power ends, the target's speed is doubled, it has a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

When the power ends, the bill comes due: the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn.
